news.title: A grandmother was shot while donating food. Now she’s unable to walk
news.summary: Dorothy Gordon, 75, says she was passing out food at the Chevron on Washington Road in East Point in July when someone shot her in the back.

news.title: Man wanted for metro Atlanta killing arrested in Florida
news.summary: A suspect has been arrested in south Alabama in connection with a metro Atlanta homicide.

news.title: 2 students arrested for bringing weapon to DeKalb County high school, principal says
news.summary: According to the school's principal, police arrested the two students, who will face both legal and disciplinary consequences.

news.title: 19-year-old deadly shooting suspect arrested; police say he was tracked by Flock
news.summary: A 19-year-old has been arrested in connection with a deadly shooting that happened over the weekend, Gwinnett County Police Department said.

news.title: 2 students arrested after report of weapon prompts Clarkston High lockdown
news.summary: Two students were arrested Thursday afternoon after reports of a weapon on campus prompted a lockdown at Clarkston High School, school officials announced.

news.title: Family of man killed on Six Flags Goliath warns against fake fundraisers
news.summary: Family members of an Atlanta educator killed at Six Flags Over Georgia are urging the public to avoid contributing to online accounts claiming to raise money in his honor.

news.title: Man shot at southwest Atlanta gas station, police say
news.summary: A man is in the hospital after a late Wednesday night shooting at a gas station in the Oakland City neighborhood, according to police.

news.title: Decatur man indicted in fatal domestic violence beating
news.summary: A 57-year-old Decatur man faces multiple murder charges after grand jurors indicted him in the fatal stabbing and beating of his ex-girlfriend inside her apartment.

news.title: Metro Atlanta man arrested in connection with shooting of former Ga. Tech, 49ers player Keion White
news.summary: White was shot in the ankle while hosting a private party at a nightclub in San Francisco following the Super Bowl on February 9, 2026, police said.

news.title: Three Atlanta residents face charges in $74 million tax fraud scheme
news.summary: Three Mexican nationals in Atlanta face federal charges of running a tax fraud scheme that stole over $74 million from the U.S. Treasury.

news.title: 7th arrest made in Carolyn Crayton Park mass shooting which left 12 hurt
news.summary: 19-year-old Aramis Tucker was arrested and charged in the shooting, which broke out at a teenager's after-hours birthday celebration at the park's skatepark.
